title: Array Complement (Elements in A but not in B)

content.problemStatement:
Given two sorted arrays find the complement i.e the task is to print the elements those are not in the second array.

For Example:

The input is : arr1 ={10,20,30,40,50} arr2={15,10,30,50}

The output is:20,40
content.inputFormat: The input has the size of the arrays and the elements for both the arrays.
content.outputFormat: Print the elements separate them by space

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find elements in array 1 that are not present in array 2.
solution.editorial: Store array 2 elements in set, output elements of array 1 not in set.
